items.prompt: Why does the line-projection helper reject direction 0?

options.text: Zero vectors cannot occur in any mathematical model
options.why: The zero vector itself is valid; it just does not define this line.

options.text: Every projection needs a positive-coordinate vector
options.why: Directions can have negative or zero coordinates.

options.text: The answer should always be a profitable portfolio
options.why: Geometry makes no such financial claim.

options.text: The denominator u dot u is 0 and no line direction is defined
options.why: A separate zero-subspace projection is a different interface.

items.explanation: The nonzero-direction condition is part of both the proof and the function contract.
